question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
  SELECT 
    pr.packaging_id AS top_id,
    pr.contains_id AS current_id,
    pr.qty AS level_qty,
    1 AS depth
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations EXCEPT SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    pt.level_qty * pr.qty,
    pt.depth + 1
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
),
leaf_ids AS (
  SELECT contains_id AS leaf_id FROM packaging_relations
  EXCEPT
  SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
),
leaf_quantities AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    SUM(pt.level_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN leaf_ids li ON li.leaf_id = pt.current_id
  GROUP BY pt.top_id
)
SELECT top_id, total_leaf_qty FROM leaf_quantities ORDER BY top_id

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
  -- Base: top-level packaging (items that are packaging_id but never contains_id)
  SELECT 
    pr.packaging_id AS top_id,
    pr.contains_id AS current_id,
    pr.qty AS level_qty,
    1 AS depth
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations EXCEPT SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recursive: expand further
  SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    pt.level_qty * pr.qty,
    pt.depth + 1
  FROM packaging_tree pt
